name: syncInsuranceData
shortDescription: Exchanges patient insurance details and eligibility information with an external insurance platform.
description:
Overview

Exchanges patient insurance details and eligibility information with an external insurance platform. This helps in verifying patient coverage and streamlining billing processes.

Intended use

This function is intended to be invoked by a scheduler (cron job) to periodically synchronize data with the InsurancePlatform. It does not require specific parameters for invocation.

Logic

  1. Call the InsurancePlatform external service using ctx.service('InsurancePlatform') to fetch or send patient insurance details.
  2. Iterate through the retrieved insurance data or prepare data to be sent.
  3. Update Patient records with new insurance information or eligibility status using ctx.data.update.
  4. Audit-log the synchronization process with ctx.audit.log, noting any updates or new records.

Entities

  • Patient

External Services

  • InsurancePlatform
